They share the same _data/papers.yml source as the academic bibliography and are identified with white_paper: true. Report or white paper Digital Security by Design Programme Outcomes Innovate UK. Programme outcomes report, 2025. Records the outcomes and evidence developed through the Digital Security by Design programme. Report or white paper CHERI Technology for Cyber Security Department for Science, Innovation and Technology. UK Government research report, 2025. Summarises CHERI's potential contribution to reducing cyber risk and improving the resilience of digital systems. Report or white paper CHERI Adoption and Diffusion Research Department for Science, Innovation and Technology. UK Government research report, 2024. Examines the potential market for CHERI and factors that may shape adoption and diffusion. Report or white paper Assessing the Viability of an Open-Source CHERI Desktop Software Ecosystem Robert N. M. Watson, Ben Laurie, and Alex Richardson. Capabilities Limited technical report, 2021. Assesses the work required to adapt a substantial open-source desktop software stack to CHERI. Report or white paper An Introduction to CHERI Robert N. M. Watson, Simon W. Moore, Peter Sewell, and Peter G. Neumann. University of Cambridge Technical Report UCAM-CL-TR-941, 2019. A high-level introduction to the CHERI architecture, microarchitecture, formal models, and software work.
